name: El Valle de Antón, Panama

rent.notes: The 2026 Live and Invest rental budget for a couple lists $900. Expat Exchange puts 3BR rents at $700-1,000 in the town center and $500-800 outside it. Few long-term house rentals were found online, and none stated a pet policy.

sources.title: Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026
Expat Exchange - Cost of Living in El Valle de Anton

groceries.notes: The 2026 Live and Invest budgets put couple groceries at $200-300. Dog food for a 100 lb dog adds roughly $50-100 a month (2023 Panama bag prices). The bigger supermarkets are in Coronado or Penonome.

sources.title: Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026
Panama America - Aumento de precios llega hasta los alimentos para perros (2023)

utilities.notes: The 2026 Live and Invest budget lists electricity $40-55, water $15 and a propane tank $8. In the highlands, electricity typically runs $25-70 because A/C is rarely needed. Internet is excluded.

sources.title: Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026
Relofirm - Panama Utilities and Electricity Costs

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

sources.title: Panama Relocation Tours - Health insurance options in Panama
Feather - Health insurance in Panama guide (Jul 2026)
Reside Panama - Healthcare in Panama 2026

insurance.notes: Renters (contents) insurance placeholder. Insurers in Panama do not publish home premiums. The old stored value meant health insurance and has been replaced.

petDaycare.notes: National boarding rates are $10-30 a night (2025). The monthly figures assume 6-8 nights a month. No El Valle boarding facility was found, so the dog may need to board in Coronado or with a sitter.

sources.title: Relofirm - Pets in Panama

petGrooming.notes: Full grooming costs $20-40 nationally. These assume about one groom a month for a Bernese, priced at the large-dog end. Local groomer availability is unconfirmed.

sources.title: Relofirm - Pets in Panama

transportation.notes: Live and Invest El Valle (2026) lists car insurance at $356 a year, fuel at $30-100 a month and upkeep at $200-350 a year. Gasoline in Anton is about $1.19-1.26 per liter (July 2026). Panama City round trips (about 240 km) add roughly $29 each, plus regular drives to Coronado for shopping.

sources.title: Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026
SNE fuel price notice 24 Jul - 7 Aug 2026 (via TVN)
Champion Motors - Car ownership costs in Panama (Jun 2026)

entertainment.notes: Live and Invest (2026) lists internet $36, cable $36 and entertainment $196, with meals out about $12 per person. No source confirms fiber in El Valle. Starlink (about $120 a month) may be the fastest option and is priced into max.

sources.title: Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026
ExpatDen - Internet Providers in Panama (Jun 2026)

phoneCell.notes: Standard Tigo or Mas Movil postpaid plans are $27 a month each, so $54 for 2 lines. The 2026 Live and Invest El Valle budget lists $35 for a couple. Check cell signal in the crater area.

sources.title: ExpatDen - Tarjetas SIM en Panama
Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: A 2026 estimate puts general doctor visits at $40-80 and specialists at $60-120, and Live and Invest lists $20 a month for medical appointments. El Valle has only basic clinics, so specialist and lab work means trips to Coronado or Panama City. That fuel is counted under transportation.

sources.title: Reside Panama - Cost of Living in Panama in 2026
Live and Invest Overseas - El Valle Cost of Living 2026

healthcare.system: Basic local clinic only. Panama City hospitals 2 hours away.
healthcare.waitTimes: Limited local options; travel required for most care
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Basic pharmacy locally; full range in Panama City

pros: Unique volcanic crater setting with cooler climate
Famous Sunday market and natural hot springs

cons.text: Very small town with limited services
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country
